findings.explanation: HOL4 gives only the POSN clause. Definition tries Defn.non_wfrec_defn first (Defn.sml:1182), which calls Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition, i.e. new_specification with just `!r c. locnrow (POSN r c) = r` (Prim_rec.sml:281). The values at UNKNOWNpt and EOFpt stay open and unrelated, and no ARB clause is saved. Lean maps both to ARB, so it proves locnrow UNKNOWNpt = ARB, locnrow UNKNOWNpt = locnrow EOFpt, and locnrow UNKNOWNpt = locncol EOFpt by rfl. None of these follows from the saved theorem.
findings.repair:
def locnrow : locn → Nat :=
  Classical.choose (show ∃ g : locn → Nat, ∀ r c, g (POSN r c) = r from
    ⟨(fun l => match l with | .POSN r _ => r | _ => 0), fun _ _ => rfl⟩)

theorem locnrow_def (r c : Nat) : locnrow (POSN r c) = r :=
  Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ g : locn → Nat, ∀ r c, g (POSN r c) = r from
    ⟨(fun l => match l with | .POSN r _ => r | _ => 0), fun _ _ => rfl⟩) r c
findings.lean_check:
